links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT answers versus recommended 8th-grade level
links.effect: ChatGPT 3.5 mean RGL 18.08 and ChatGPT 4 mean RGL 17.9, exceeding the average American reading grade level by 10.08 and 9.09 grade levels respectively.
links.quote: However, readability levels for both versions significantly exceeded the average 8th-grade reading level for American patients.

links.outcome: Comprehensibility (readability) of AI-generated patient education content
links.effect: Mean RGL of 18.08 (ChatGPT 3.5) and 17.9 (ChatGPT 4), far above the 8th-grade level of average American adults.
links.quote: While ChatGPT can provide both reliable and good quality information on ACL injuries and treatment options, the readability of the content may limit its utility.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality (DISCERN) and readability of ChatGPT-generated patient education materials on ACL injury without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
